keyEvents.text: Stanley Mills (Preston North End) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Keven Schlotterbeck (Southampton).
Substitution, Southampton. Zach Abbott replaces Keven Schlotterbeck because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Liam Lindsay (Preston North End) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Preston North End 1, Southampton 0. Jordan Thompson (Preston North End) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner.
Andrew Hughes (Preston North End) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Andrew Hughes (Preston North End).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
